svg.title: WriteFlow — Full-stack blogging
svg.desc: A complete publishing platform: roles, a rich-text editor, media uploads, comments, likes, search and an admin dashboard, on serverless Postgres. Built with Next.js 15, Neon Postgres, TipTap, JWT.

g.text: A complete publishing platform: roles, a rich-text editor,
media uploads, comments, likes, search and an admin
